name: Bison
otherStatistics: Initiative +0. AC is 13 (−1 size, +4 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 13. Space/reach 10 ft./5 ft. Base attack +3. Grapple +13. Fortitude +7, Reflex +4, Will +1.
appearance: A broad, shaggy bison with a high shoulder hump, heavy forequarters, and short upward-curving horns.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Revised v3.5 SRD, MonstersAnimals.rtf, Bison. https://www.d20srd.org/srd/monsters/bison.htm
sections.Special qualities:
Low-light vision. See twice as far as a human in dim illumination while retaining color and detail.
Scent. Detect opponents by smell within 30 ft., or 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double those ranges and overpowering odors triple them. A move action identifies the direction of a scent. At 5 ft. or closer, pinpoint the source.
sections.Skills and feats:
Skills. Listen +7, Spot +5.
Feats. Alertness, Endurance. Endurance grants +4 on the checks and saves listed for the feat, including Constitution checks to keep running, hold breath or withstand a forced march.
sections.Encounter ecology: Environment. Temperate plains. Organization. Solitary or herd (6–30). Bison usually flee. They may become aggressive while protecting their young or during mating season. Treasure none. Advancement. 6–7 HD (Large). Level adjustment none listed.
sections.Special attacks: Stampede (Ex). A frightened herd flees together in a random direction away from the perceived danger. It runs over anything of Large size or smaller in its path and deals 1d12 damage for each five bison in the herd. Reflex DC 18 halves the damage. The save DC is Strength-based.

name: Camel
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC is 13 (−1 size, +3 Dex, +1 natural), touch 12, flat-footed 10. Space/reach 10 ft./5 ft. Base attack +2. Grapple +10. Fortitude +5, Reflex +6, Will +1.
appearance: A sandy dromedary with one hump, long legs, an arched neck and broad two-toed feet.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Revised v3.5 SRD, MonstersAnimals.rtf, Camel. https://www.d20srd.org/srd/monsters/camel.htm
sections.Attack: Bite +0 melee, 1d4 + 2 damage. The bite is secondary and adds half the Strength bonus.
sections.Special qualities:
Low-light vision. See twice as far as a human in dim illumination while retaining color and detail.
Scent. Detect opponents by smell within 30 ft., or 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double those ranges and overpowering odors triple them. A move action identifies the direction of a scent. At 5 ft. or closer, pinpoint the source.
sections.Skills and feats:
Skills. Listen +5, Spot +5.
Feats. Alertness, Endurance. Endurance grants +4 on the checks and saves listed for the feat, including Constitution checks to keep running, hold breath or withstand a forced march.
sections.Encounter ecology: Environment. Warm deserts. Organization. Domesticated or herd (6–30). The dromedary stands about 7 ft. at the shoulder, with its hump about 1 ft. higher. Camels can travel long distances without food or water. Treasure none. Advancement. None listed. Level adjustment none listed.
sections.Carrying capacity: Light load up to 300 lb. Medium load 301–600 lb. Heavy load 601–900 lb. Drag limit 4,500 lb.
sections.Bactrian camel: The two-humped variety is stockier and suited to cooler, rocky terrain. Its speed is 40 ft. and Constitution is 16.

name: Dire Rat
otherStatistics: Initiative +3. AC is 15 (+1 size, +3 Dex, +1 natural), touch 14, flat-footed 12. Space/reach 5 ft./5 ft. Base attack +0. Grapple -4. Fortitude +3, Reflex +5, Will +3.
appearance: A low, bristly brown rat with a long curved bare tail, a pointed snout and prominent incisors.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Revised v3.5 SRD, MonstersDi-Do.rtf, Dire Animal, Dire Rat. https://www.d20srd.org/srd/monsters/direRat.htm
sections.Attack: Bite +4 melee, 1d4 damage plus exposure to filth fever.
sections.Full attack: One Bite +4 melee, 1d4 damage plus exposure to filth fever.
sections.Special qualities:
Low-light vision. See twice as far as a human in dim illumination while retaining color and detail.
Scent. Detect opponents by smell within 30 ft., or 60 ft. upwind and 15 ft. downwind. Strong odors double those ranges and overpowering odors triple them. A move action identifies the direction of a scent. At 5 ft. or closer, pinpoint the source.
sections.Skills and feats:
Skills. Climb +11, Hide +8, Listen +4, Move Silently +4, Spot +4, Swim +11. Apply the printed +8 racial bonuses to Climb and Swim. Both checks use Dexterity. The rat can take 10 on Climb even while rushed or threatened.
Feats. Alertness, Weapon Finesse (bonus feat).
sections.Encounter ecology: Environment. Any. Organization. Solitary or pack (11–20). Dire rats scavenge, defend their nests and territory, and attack boldly in packs. Treasure none. Advancement. 2–3 HD (Small), 4–6 HD (Medium). Level adjustment none listed.
sections.Special attacks: Disease (Ex), filth fever. A bitten creature makes an immediate DC 11 Fortitude save. On failure, incubation lasts 1d3 days, then the creature takes 1d3 Dexterity and 1d3 Constitution damage. Each day afterward, a failed DC 11 Fortitude save repeats the damage. Two consecutive successful daily saves end the disease. The DC is Constitution-based.

name: Giant Crocodile
otherStatistics: Initiative +1. AC is 16 (−2 size, +1 Dex, +7 natural), touch 9, flat-footed 15. Space/reach 15 ft./10 ft. Base attack +5. Grapple +21. Fortitude +9, Reflex +6, Will +3.
appearance: A low, broad-snouted crocodile with armored olive-brown scales, short splayed legs and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Revised v3.5 SRD, MonstersAnimals.rtf, Crocodile, Giant, and Crocodile combat. https://www.d20srd.org/srd/monsters/crocodile.htm#giantCrocodile
sections.Attack: Bite +11 melee for 2d8 + 12 damage, or Tail Slap +11 melee for 1d12 + 12 damage.
sections.Full attack: One Bite +11 melee for 2d8 + 12 damage, or one Tail Slap +11 melee for 1d12 + 12 damage.
sections.Special qualities:
Hold Breath (Ex). It can hold its breath for four times its Constitution score, or 76 rounds, before it risks drowning.
Low-light vision. See twice as far as a human in dim illumination while retaining color and detail.
sections.Skills and feats:
Skills. Hide +1, Listen +5, Spot +5, Swim +16. In water, add a +4 racial bonus to Hide. At the surface with only eyes and nostrils exposed, it also gets +10 cover to Hide. The +8 racial Swim bonus applies to special actions and hazards. It can take 10 on Swim while distracted or endangered, and can run when swimming in a straight line.
Feats. Alertness, Endurance, Skill Focus (Hide). Endurance adds +4 to Constitution checks to hold breath after the listed interval.
sections.Encounter ecology: Environment. Warm marshes, Salt water. Organization. Solitary or colony (6–11). Giant crocodiles use the smaller crocodile’s ambush behavior, waiting low in the water and trying to drag a grabbed victim deeper. Treasure none. Advancement. 8–14 HD (Huge). Level adjustment none listed.
sections.Special attacks: Improved Grab (Ex). After it hits a Large or smaller foe with Bite, the crocodile can immediately attempt a grapple as a free action without a touch attack or an attack of opportunity. On a win, it draws the target into its space and may drag it if the victim is within its drag limit. It can grapple normally or hold with its jaws at −20 on grapple checks to avoid becoming grappled itself. Winning the initial grab adds no damage. Later successful grapple checks with the hold deal Bite damage. The crocodile uses opposed grapple checks to pin or move a struggling target.
sections.At the table: A target escapes with an opposed grapple check in place of an attack or a standard-action Escape Artist check against the crocodile’s grapple check. Escaping a pin leaves the target in the grapple. After the crocodile’s breath-holding interval, use escalating Constitution checks beginning at DC 10. Failure starts drowning, with 0 HP and unconsciousness on the first round, −1 HP on the next, and death on the third.

name: Monkey
otherStatistics: Initiative +2. AC is 14 (+2 size, +2 Dex), touch 14, flat-footed 12. Space/reach 2-1/2 ft./0 ft. Base attack +0. Grapple -12. Fortitude +2, Reflex +4, Will +1.
appearance: A small dark-bodied monkey with a pale face and neck, long fingers, and a coiled tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Revised v3.5 SRD, MonstersAnimals.rtf, Monkey. https://www.d20srd.org/srd/monsters/monkey.htm
sections.Special qualities: Low-light vision. See twice as far as a human in dim illumination while retaining color and detail.
sections.Skills and feats:
Skills. Balance +10, Climb +10, Hide +10, Listen +3, Spot +3. It has a +8 racial bonus to Balance and Climb. Climb uses Dexterity. The monkey can take 10 on Climb even while rushed or threatened.
Feats. Weapon Finesse.
sections.Encounter ecology: Environment. Warm forests. Organization. Troop (10–40). Monkeys retreat into the trees when possible and bite when cornered. This profile covers arboreal monkeys up to house-cat size. Treasure none. Advancement. 2–3 HD (Small). Level adjustment none listed.
sections.At the table: The 3.5 combat minimum gives the monkey 1 damage on a hit after penalties. With 0-ft. reach, it enters the target’s space to bite and normally provokes an attack of opportunity for doing so.
